settings.introZh: 这里记录我长期体验过的游戏、游玩时长、完成情况与部分设计观察。Steam 记录可批量导入；主机、手游和其他平台游戏可以手动补充。
settings.introEn: A record of games I have spent meaningful time with, including playtime, completion status, achievements, and selected design observations. Steam records can be imported in bulk, while console, mobile, and other titles can be added manually.
settings.steamNoteZh: Steam 主页用于核对公开的游戏库与游玩时长；本页也包含非 Steam 游戏，因此两边不会完全一致。
settings.steamNoteEn: My public Steam profile can be used to verify library and playtime data. This page also includes non-Steam titles, so the two lists are not expected to match exactly.
